method: Independent parsing of saved exact Dicke coefficients; rational row reduction checks every complete cross matrix against the defining equations. Fraction arithmetic independently reconstructs the Jacobian/Hessians and verifies a Newton-map Banach certificate with the separate bound ||I-RJ0||∞+r||R||∞ max_l sum_ij |H_lij|. No case-specific verifier or definition module is imported.
mathematicalJustification: The closed rational box is complete. The Newton map x−RF(x) maps it strictly into itself and contracts, so it has exactly one fixed point.
The inverse defect is below one, making R and every Jacobian in the box nonsingular; a fixed point therefore satisfies F(x)=0.
A nonsingular isolated zero of a square rational polynomial system has algebraic coordinates.
Every full cross reduction equals delta_ab I3/3 at that root. Tracing gives an orthonormal basis, so every normalized vector in its span is second-order AC.
